metadata.question: Were there fires in Pedrógão Grande during the any time between June 16 to June 20, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Pedrógão Grande, Portugal (known for devastating fires in June 2017) - Date: June 16-20, 2017 - Collection: MODIS or VIIRS fire products are best for fire detection - Use FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) data: MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or MODIS/006/MYD14A1 (Terra/Aqua fire products) - Or use MODIS Thermal Anomalies: MODIS/006/MOD14A2 or FIRMS MODIS/VIIRS 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we're detecting fires/thermal anomalies - Look for fire mask band or thermal anomaly pixels - Fire detection uses thermal bands, not affected by clouds 3. Logic: - If fire pixels detected in the region during this period → A: Yes - If no fire pixels detected → B: No - If collection is empty → C1 - If no valid pixels after processing → C2 - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location - Pedrógão Grande, Portugal const pedrogao = ee.Geometry.Point([-8.1458, 39.9833]); const region = pedrogao.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer to cover the fire area // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2017-06-16'; const endDate = '2017-06-21'; // 3. Load MODIS fire product (Terra) let fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Fire Images Found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try FIRMS MODIS data as fallback fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const firmsSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`FIRMS Images Found: ${firmsSize}`); if (firmsSize === 0) { console.log("No fire detection data available for this period."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 4. Process fire detection - use FireMask band const fireMosaic = fireCol.select('FireMask').max(); // 5. Count fire pixels (FireMask > 7 indicates fire with varying confidence) const fireStats = fireMosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.sum(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = fireStats.FireMask_count || 0; const fireSum = fireStats.FireMask_sum || 0; console.log(`Total Pixels Analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Fire Pixels Sum: ${fireSum}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (fireSum === null || fireSum === undefined) { console.log("Fire calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Determine answer // FireMask values: 7-9 indicate fire detections const fireDetected = fireSum > 0; console.log(`Fire Detection Result: ${fireDetected ? 'FIRES DETECTED' : 'No fires detected'}`); if (fireDetected) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
